svg.title: Reading a tender package
svg.desc: 1. The file is checked by content, not by name; tender packages accept PDF only. 2. A worker thread parses pages with pdf.js, removes repeated headers and footers and splits two-language columns. 3. Clauses and sub-items are segmented, including layered A, B and C conditions, and labelled with the file role. 4. Scanned pages go through OCR. 5. The text is indexed for keyword and vector search, encrypted at rest.
svg.text: The file is checked by content,
A, B and C conditions, and
The text is indexed for keyword
